title: Shopping is moving into AI assistants while memory costs squeeze PCs
summary: Amazon added 100+ Alexa for Shopping functions, opened merchant registration and began text shopping; Walmart upgraded Sparky; Visa found AI models fail 43% of shopping tests. Apple warned of margin drop on memory costs; Samsung sees shortage to 2028.

points.headline: Assistants from Amazon and Walmart are becoming shopping channels
points.detail: Amazon added 100+ Alexa functions, opened merchant sign-up and began text shopping; Walmart added cart generation to Sparky. We should check how our products and feeds surface in them.

points.headline: Agent checkout is promising but still unreliable
points.detail: Visa found AI models fail 43% of shopping test runs, while Mastercard is forming OpenAI and Tencent partnerships. We should test how agents handle our store before relying on them.

points.headline: Memory costs are hitting PC margins and demand through 2028
points.detail: Apple forecasts a holiday-quarter margin drop, mobile SoC shipments fall nearly 20%, and Samsung sees the shortage lasting to 2028. We should plan pricing and promotions around component inflation.

points.headline: Apple is planning a big entry-level laptop push
points.detail: Apple told suppliers to plan 16M MacBook Neo units in 2027, double 2026. Expect more price and promo pressure in entry notebooks.

points.headline: Marketplace costs rise as new channels open
points.detail: Amazon seller fees and ads hit $66.1B in Q3 while TikTok launched a stand-alone Shop app. We should weigh channel margin against growing our own store.
